source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/thebigtg/bananatree04 (all 7 menu pages: all day, express lunch, bottomless bowls, bottomless brunch, kids, desserts, drinks; downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; menus.tenkites.com robots.txt allows them)
notes: Fresh pages re-run through banana_tree.py reproduced data/source exactly. Independent read: headless Chromium over all 281 pop-ups (own DOM selectors, not the script's parser) plus the pages' JSON-LD for dish/option names; all 141 published items match on kcal, protein, carbs, fat, saturates, sugars, salt, the Contains / May contain lines and the vegetarian marks (numbers incl. 1,376-style thousands separators; kJ and fibre are not printed). 26 allergen rows had cereal or tree-nut KINDS that policy 2 says to drop: the page prints e.g. 'Contains: Cereals (Barley)' and 'May contain: Cereals (Wheat)', but tenkites_b.allergens_from_rec removes the overlap before common.write_allergens can see it, so the files named only barley. banana_tree.py now puts the allergen back into may_contain in that case (allergens_of), allergens.csv regenerated: those 26 rows now publish the generic gluten / nuts. 7 audit flags (5 salt/sugar rows and Lychee Juice kcal printed as such, Extra Katsu Sauce has no soya on the page) marked ok.
